q: What tells a client which authorization server an MCP server trusts?
options: A hard-coded list in the client
The server’s protected-resource metadata, pointed to in its 401 response
explain: RFC 9728 metadata lets clients discover the authorization server.

q: What does the resource indicator do in the authorization request?
options: Names the MCP server, so the token is audience-bound to it
explain: RFC 8707 binds the token to the intended resource.

q: An MCP server needs to call a CRM API. What should it do with the token it received?
options: Never forward it; obtain a separate token for the CRM
Put it in the tool result
